answer.reason: The verses tell of his fall and lameness, David's kindness to him, and his being spared, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was dropped by his nurse as she fled and became lame in both feet
clauses.quote: as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame

clauses.english: was shown kindness by David, who restored Saul's land to him and seated him at the king's table
clauses.quote: thou shalt eat bread at my table continually

clauses.english: was spared by David when Saul's sons were given up to the Gibeonites, because of the LORD's oath

doubts: 2SA 21:8 names another Mephibosheth, a son of Rizpah, who was hanged; left out.
1CH 8:34 and 9:40 call him Meribbaal and only list his descent, so they were not used.
Ziba's claim in 2SA 16:3 and David's grant to Ziba in 16:4 and 19:29 are disputed, so the division of the land was left out.
